results.message: What time can I check in?
results.reply: Check‑in starts at 2:00 PM. Early check‑in is free if rooms are available. Let me know if you need to request it.
Check‑out time is 12:00 PM (noon). If you need a late checkout, just let us know and we’ll try to accommodate.
The daily rate is RM45 per night.

Pelangi Capsule Hostel is at 26A Jalan Perang, Taman Pelangi, 80400 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. It’s close to Plaza Pelangi and the Pelangi Leisure Mall. Let us know if you need a route from your location!

Pelangi offers free Wi‑Fi, air‑conditioned private capsules with bedding, power outlets, reading light, lockers, hot showers, shared kitchen (microwave, kettle, cookware), common lounge, work desks, laundry (RM5/load), and luggage storage. Enjoy a comfy stay! — Rainbow 🌈

results.message: Can I book a room for this Friday?
results.reply: Hi! I'm Rainbow, your AI assistant here at Pelangi Hostel 🌈. Great news, our capsules are almost always available! To help you book for this Friday, could you please tell me your full check-in and check-out dates, and how many guests will be staying? 😊

Hi! I'm Rainbow, your AI assistant here at Pelangi Hostel 🌈. We have limited on-site parking, so it's best to contact us in advance if you need a guaranteed spot. There's also off-site public street parking nearby, which costs RM 0.60 per hour during working hours and is free outside of those times, Sundays, and public holidays. Motorbike parking is available along the front of the building for free. — Rainbow 🌈
No, breakfast is not included in the room rate. You can use our fully‑equipped shared kitchen or visit nearby eateries for meals.
